text:
nina: Quick note 1: I'm kicking off a tiny docs migration for function/tool calling examples. Goal: split the big page into 3 tiny anchorable snippets (invoke, schema, fallback) so SDK READMEs can link directly.

jordan: Sounds good. What anchor naming convention are we using?

nina: Kebab-case headings: # snippet-invoke, # snippet-schema, # snippet-fallback. Keep IDs stable (no generated hashes).

rachel: I'll take the SDK snippet UI work (copy button + language label). I have a small React Snippet component we can reuse.

diego: I'll write the JSON schemas. Plan: minimal required props only, "nullable": false for required fields, and one example of an extra-field shim. Example extra tool output I plan to show: `{
  "id": 42,
  "result": "OK",
  "meta": { "duration_ms": 120 }
}` then schema that expects only id and result.

sam: I'll add the parse fallback blurb: order = strict JSON -> tolerant JSON parse -> regex fallback. Also add a tiny CLI test that demonstrates fallback applied.

jordan: Note for cross-version docs: show both SDK 3.x and 4.x invocation examples. e.g. 3.x `client.invoke({ name: 'send_email', input })` vs 4.x `client.tools.invoke('send_email', input)`. Label them clearly.

rachel: Example TS copyable snippet I'll add:
```ts
const res = await client.invoke({
  name: 'summarize',
  input: { text: longText }
});
console.log(res.output);
```
I'll wrap it with <Snippet lang="ts" copy /> in the markdown.

diego: Tiny gotcha: in schema examples prefer explicit types (e.g., "type": "integer") not just example values. I'll keep each schema under 15 lines.

nina: Nice. Checklist for the PRs: 1) break page into 3 anchored code blocks, 2) add <Snippet> wrappers and copy buttons, 3) add minimal JSON schema + example, 4) include one-line parse-fallback note + CLI test, 5) run link-checker on the page and fix anchors.

docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/func-toolcall-snippets-PR-198 (CI green) :white_check_mark:

nina: Timeline: open PRs by Friday EOD. Prefix PR titles with `docs: invoke snippets`.

jordan: I'll open the split/anchor PR (will only change headings and fences) by Friday morning.

rachel: SDK snippet PR opening later today.

diego: Schema PR Thursday EOD. I'll include the shim example and a brief note on how to patch consumers.

sam: Parse fallback + small test PR by Friday afternoon.

nina: When you open PRs, add a one-line changelog entry for the docs release notes. If you hit cross-page broken links, flag me and we'll run the site link-checker.

rachel: tagging nina on my PR.

diego: I'll also include a short example of handling an extra `meta` field in client-side code (simple destructuring shim).

nina: Thanks team. If anything needs further scoping, ping me in-thread or DM. :thumbsup:
